q: Lower perplexity means a language model…
options: assigns higher probability to the text being measured
explain: Perplexity is the exponential of cross-entropy on the text; lower is better on the same data and tokenizer.

q: What is the entropy of a uniform choice among four outcomes?
What does cross-entropy loss punish most?
explain: −ln p grows sharply as p falls.

q: Why not compare perplexities across models with different tokenizers?
options: Tokens differ, so per-token perplexities measure different units
explain: Normalize by characters or bytes instead.
